usage_requirements: No query:/passage: prefixes required (symmetric usage for queries and documents)
Mean (average) pooling over last hidden states masked by attention_mask; the model card's transformers example implements this manually — do not use CLS pooling
trust_remote_code NOT required (vanilla BertModel architecture); loads with stock transformers, sentence-transformers, and HF text-embeddings-inference
English-only; inputs longer than 512 tokens are silently truncated
Normalize embeddings (F.normalize) before cosine similarity, per the model card usage example
known_issues: Cosine similarities are compressed into a high range — unrelated sentences commonly score ~0.7-0.8 (documented for the GTE v1 family in HF discussion thenlper/gte-large/discussions/7); absolute-threshold cutoffs are unreliable, use relative ranking
512-token hard truncation silently drops the tail of long documents

Do not confuse with the newer Alibaba-NLP/gte-*-en-v1.5 and gte-multilingual models, which use a custom RoPE architecture requiring trust_remote_code and have various loader-compatibility issues; thenlper/gte-base (v1) is plain BERT and unaffected
unknowns: independent (non-self-reported) MTEB leaderboard verification of the 62.39 average — the embeddings-benchmark/results repo has a thenlper__gte-base entry but its contents could not be loaded, so all benchmark numbers are flagged self_reported
